figurative_meaning_en: A specific type of paralytic disease
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাবা পক্ষাঘাতে আক্রান্ত হয়ে শয্যাশায়ী হয়ে পড়েছেন।
পক্ষাঘাতের পর থেকে তার চলাফেরা বন্ধ হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His father has been bedridden after suffering a stroke.
Movement has stopped for him since the paralysis.
note: This term is primarily medical rather than purely idiomatic, but commonly used in Bengali for describing stroke-related paralysis.
